events.description_zh: 夜间灯会 Wild Lights: Passport to Wonder，11 月 12 日到 2027 年 1 月 5 日每晚都开，12 月 24、25、26 日关。17:00 开，21:00 关，最晚 19:30 入场，进去后可以慢慢走。九个灯区，含爱尔兰民间故事和圣诞。指定日期的票仍在卖；工作日灵活票已售罄。凤凰公园夜里冷，婴儿车可以，带外套。
events.address: Phoenix Park, Dublin 8, D08 AC98

price.note_zh: 指定日期票：成人 €26.50，儿童（3–15 岁）€22，3 岁以下免费，老人或学生 €23.50。热门日期会满。灵活工作日票已售罄
price.note_en: Dated tickets: adult €26.50, child (3–15) €22, under 3 free, senior or student €23.50. Popular dates sell out. Flexible weekday tickets are sold out

events.booking_zh: 按日期在动物园票务页买
events.description_en: The after-dark trail Wild Lights: Passport to Wonder. Open every night from 12 November to 5 January 2027, closed 24, 25 and 26 December. Flexible weekday tickets are sold out. Phoenix Park is cold at night. Buggies are fine. Bring a coat.
events.schedule_note_en: Every night 17:00–21:00, last entry 19:30; closed 24–26 December
